message.content:
An editorial magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, dark brown letters features a central illustration of a person's head and neck. The individual is shouting with eyes closed, mouth wide open, and teeth visible. From the top and right side of the head, countless small hashtag symbols (#) appear to break away and float into the white background. A large, black hashtag symbol sits next to the word "PERANG". Below this, smaller black text reads: "ADU KUAT DI MEDIA SOSIAL MENJADI PEMANASAN MENJELANG PEMILU 2019. SIAPA BERADA DI BELAKANG DUA KELOMPOK YANG BERSETERU?"

At the top left, text reads "SETELAH ARTIDJO ALKOSTAR PENSIUN". To the top right, it says "MENJARING ZAKAT LEWAT APLIKASI". Below the main title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is printed. In the bottom left corner, a barcode is situated next to the date "4-10 JUNI 2018", price "RP 45.000", and website "WWW.TEMPO.CO". A thin red border runs along the left edge of the cover. The illustration is rendered in a realistic, painterly style with neutral skin tones.
